_meta.methodology: Researched current operator, university, and nonprofit facility pages on 2026-08-16. Prioritized official location pages and official membership or pass pages. Recorded a publicly displayed base adult or open-gym rate when the source clearly associated it with the operator or location. Used null and an explicit note when pricing was not published, eligibility-limited, promotional, or could not be safely mapped to one physical location. Checked names and addresses against data/imports/sf-gyms-osm.json and omitted obvious exact-address duplicates. Neighborhood labels are normalized from the official address or operator neighborhood description; coordinates are included only when an official source exposed a confident coordinate.
_meta.deduplication: Supplemental research only. Existing OSM records for obvious exact-address matches such as Bakar, Fitness SF, Movement, the existing Crunch clubs, existing Equinox clubs, existing Live Fit clubs, existing Planet Fitness 417 Montgomery, and existing YMCA branches were omitted.
